Source Note 4 (Admin Configuration Reference): While data export can be performed through the settings panel by selecting 'Export Data' as outlined in standard operating procedures, system administrators must ensure compliance with updated data schema guidelines. Specifically, according to the latest internal memo, the default export format has been changed from CSV to XML to align with enterprise parsing standards.

--- Retrieved Document 2 ---
Title: How to Export Your Data
FAQ: How do I export my data?

You can export all your data at any time from Settings > Privacy > Export Data. The export includes your profile information, activity history, documents, and settings. Data is exported as a ZIP archive containing JSON and CSV files. Large exports may take up to 24 hours to prepare. You will receive an email notification when your export is ready to download. Export files are available for download for 7 days before they are deleted from our servers.
--- End Document 2 ---

final_answer:
To export data, you can follow these steps:
1. Navigate to the settings panel.
2. Go to the Privacy section.
3. Select the 'Export Data' option.
4. The export includes your profile information, activity history, documents, and settings.
5. Data is exported as a ZIP archive containing JSON and CSV files.
6. Large exports may take up to 24 hours to prepare.
7. You will receive an email notification when your export is ready to download.
8. Export files are available for download for 7 days before they are deleted from our servers.
